note: carry::access v4 on Sui mainnet. The gate is default-deny: an agent is granted a namespace explicitly or it reads nothing. Receipts are versioned, nonce-protected and expiring.

exampleReceipts.note: Both pass all four checks. The tampered one claims `billing`, which was never granted — under default-deny it is refused without needing an explicit revoke.

gateReads.note: Read from mainnet after granting aria three namespaces. An unconfigured agent and an unknown namespace both read false — before the grants, every pair read false.

walrus.note: Walrus mainnet has no public publisher by design (publishing spends the operator’s SUI and WAL), so blobs are written with the walrus CLI paying from this wallet.

vault.note: Portable memory: the wallet owns the vault, the vault names the Walrus manifest and its digest, and the manifest lists the memory blobs. A wallet alone is enough to recover the vault on another device.

securityProofsOnChain.replayed_nonce_rejected: anchoring twice with the same nonce aborts with code 2 (ENonceAlreadyUsed)

previousVersion.note: v3 — versioned and replay-protected, but the gate was still default-allow. Receipts minted here keep verifying; the verifier resolves each receipt's package from its own type.
